newsitem.title: USA: Pinkerton to appeal $10 million Detroit jury.
newsitem.headline: Pinkerton to appeal $10 million Detroit jury.

text.p: Security firm Pinkerton's Inc said it will appeal a Michigan jury's $10 million verdict in the case of Sean McBride of Detroit.
McBride was shot January 1994 by a man who had been making comments about his homosexuality. It happened by a building where an unarmed Pinkerton security officer was stationed.
Pinkerton said it acted appropriately and could not have prevented the incident from occurring. It believes the jury verdict will be overturned by the appellate court."
Pinkerton has adequate insurance protection to cover a substantial portion of the verdict in the event that the appeal is not overturned.
